source_summary: Tall monochrome Chinese landscape with steep layered mountains, a narrow gorge descending to a village and waterside foreground, with trees, plank bridges, buildings, water ripples, and small traveler figures. Calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded from motifs.

motifs.name: distant_rounded_peak
motifs.description: Isolate the pale central background mountain peak rising behind the gorge, including its broad rounded summit, soft grey wash, faint contour strokes, and mist-softened lower edges; exclude nearby inscription/seals and the darker foreground wooded ridges.
must_preserve: soft layered grey wash on the summit
misty transition at the mountain base

motifs.name: left_sheer_cliff
motifs.description: Isolate the tall left-side cliff wall forming the left edge of the ravine, including the vertical striated rock face, pale eroded slopes, ink-dotted vegetation, and the dark narrow cleft along its right edge; exclude red seals at the far left and central village below.
must_preserve: pale wash gradients across the cliff face
clusters of small dark vegetation dots

motifs.name: upper_right_wooded_ridge
motifs.description: Isolate the upper right mountain mass with rounded bouldery forms and dense scrub, including the layered rock shelves, stippled foliage, and grey-black ink accents cascading down the slope; avoid the pale distant peak behind it.
must_preserve: soft grey wash on overlapping rock shelves

motifs.name: central_misty_gorge
motifs.description: Isolate the narrow vertical gorge between the mountain walls, including the pale mist or waterfall channel, dark flanking vegetation, and receding V-shaped depth through the center of the composition; exclude adjacent large cliff faces as much as possible.
must_preserve: dark dotted vegetation lining both sides
soft mist edges blending into rock

motifs.name: middle_plank_bridge
motifs.description: Isolate the long elevated wooden plank bridge crossing the ravine in the middle distance, including its zigzag railing, repeated vertical posts, slatted deck, and the rocky supports beneath; exclude the lower village roofs and foreground trees.

motifs.name: lower_left_waterside_village
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-left cluster of waterside buildings, including tiled and thatched roof geometry, wall panels, porch railings, a seated interior figure, adjacent rippled water, and small fence lines; exclude the large central tree trunks where possible.
must_preserve: layered roof tiles and thatch strokes
small seated figure visible inside the open room

motifs.name: central_pine_and_tree_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the dense central foreground grove rising in front of the village, including tall pale trunks, dark pine needle clusters, bamboo-like verticals, tangled branches, and shrubs rooted among rocks; exclude buildings behind it as much as possible.
must_preserve: pale twisting trunks with ink outlines
rock and shrub bases with stippled texture

motifs.name: foreground_scholar_bridge
motifs.description: Isolate the bottom foreground footbridge with small traveler or scholar figures and attendants crossing over rippled water, including the simple railings, posts, bank contours, and nearby low pavilion platform at the water edge; exclude the red seal at the bottom right.
must_preserve: tiny human figure linework and poses
small pavilion or platform roof edge nearby

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
